negative_snippets:
Decent Stay with Scope for Improvement

Stayed at Hotel Amrapali Grand, Patel Nagar from 25th to 28th October 2025. It’s a decent hotel with basic amenities and a good location right on the main road, close to Rajendra Place Metro Station (Blue Line). Public transport — bus, taxi, auto, and metro — is easily accessible.

Pros:

Convenient location with easy connectivity.
Housekeeping staff (especially on the first floor) were prompt and kept the rooms clean.
Rooms have electric kettle, tea/coffee setup, and bathrooms are equipped with dental kits, soap, and shampoo.
Towels changed daily.
Breakfast spread is good, and the tea and coffee taste excellent.

Cons:

Being on the main road, there’s continuous traffic noise.
Disturbance from other guests late at night — despite complaining thrice, it wasn’t resolved.
Reception staff were not very welcoming and a bit slow to respond.
There is no place to sit in the reception, like a couch or a sofa could be better as soon as you enter with luggage.
Breakfast quality could be improved — good variety but average taste.
Cleanliness and room service could be better.
Faced issues with checkout date and advance payment, but staff did rectify both quickly once pointed out.

Overall, it’s a reasonably priced hotel suitable for a short 1–2 night stay, especially for those prioritising location and basic comfort over luxury.

Writing this review after my 3 days stay (club room)

Room was spacious. Staff were curtious. Celing fan and exhaust fan in the washroom make lot of noise, there are some sort of flies in the room. washroom stinks a bit when ever you keep the room closed and come back.

Food - complimentary breakfast - nothing tasted good other than poori and sabji.

In room dining - food was good, however felt overpriced for the taste and quality.

Staff - most of the staff and welcoming and greet you with a smile.

Very disappointing experience at Hotel Amrapali Grand. The room was not clean, and we even found cockroaches — totally unacceptable for a place claiming to be a 4-star hotel. The hygiene and maintenance were poor, and the overall service didn’t meet basic standards. Definitely not worth the money.
